about: The Karamja Volcano and the Crandor and Karamja Dungeon below it (Karamja step K1.4): imps and scorpions on the slopes; deadly red spiders, giant bats, lesser demons, skeletons and rats below. Types and tiles are mejrs's data_osrs NPCList_OSRS.json (NPCs seen on live), counts checked against the Wiki's location pages. Left out: Elvarg (the quest kills her for good), Dallas Jones (Dragon Slayer II), the monkeys (no combat data yet); the snakes on the east slope are Musa Point's (K1.3).
